description: This stacked bar chart compares the composition of two categories, labeled “Ours” and “Standard,” along the vertical axis, with each bar segmented into three colored parts representing “Context” (blue), “Generated Response” (brown), and “Other” (green), as indicated by the legend below the chart. The horizontal axis represents the percentage composition of each segment within its respective bar. For the “Ours” bar, the blue “Context” segment constitutes 60.6%, the brown “Generated Response” segment is 31.7%, and the green “Other” segment is 7.7%. For the “Standard” bar, the blue “Context” segment is 23.6%, the brown “Generated Response” segment is 51.1%, and the green “Other” segment is 25.3%. The chart uses a linear scale for the horizontal axis, with percentages ranging from 0% to 100%, and the tick marks are spaced at regular intervals corresponding to the percentage values shown. The bars are presented side-by-side without any sorting or emphasis, allowing for a direct visual comparison of the segmental composition between the two categories.
